theme: An open Sunday before a Toronto week.
greeting: A quiet, open Sunday, Dan — the one short review is already behind you and the rest of the day is yours. The thing worth squaring away is tomorrow's Toronto trip.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas rental still open
needsAttention.detail: The p1 board item to book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is well past due. PWM holiday SUV inventory is the thinnest in that market and genuinely sells out.

needsAttention.title: December break has no destination
needsAttention.detail: The Dec 13–Jan 2 trip with all four girls still has nothing booked; the plan was decide by Sept 30, book by Oct 15, and holiday inventory for six keeps thinning.

needsAttention.title: Toronto flight Monday afternoon
needsAttention.detail: Porter PD526 leaves Tampa at 4:20 PM tomorrow for Toronto — worth packing and checking in tonight, before the evening handoff.

flagged.title: Two board-adjacent roles surfaced
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged a KLA VP of Global Government Affairs and a Ripple VP of Corporate Development — both squarely in your governance and public-affairs lane.
